name: Save the Date
message: Namaste. With blessings of our elders, we invite you to save the date for the Vivah Sanskar on 25 November 2026 in Vadodara. Detailed schedule will follow.

name: RSVP Reminder
message: Namaste. Please confirm your attendance and guest count for the wedding functions. Also share if accommodation or pickup is required.

name: Accommodation Info
message: Your accommodation details are ready. Please keep your ID proof handy for check-in and contact the accommodation desk on arrival.

name: Pickup Reminder
message: Pickup reminder: Please share live location after arrival and keep your phone reachable. Our pickup coordinator will contact you shortly.

name: Function Schedule Update
message: Schedule update: Please arrive on time for the next function. Elders and outstation guests may contact the family desk for assistance.
